description: Apply an existing Space tag to a task. The tag must already exist in the task's Space (create it first with `create_space_tag` if needed). Returns a confirmation.

custom_task_ids.description: Set true when `task_id` is a custom task ID instead of a native ClickUp ID. Requires `team_id`.

tag_name.description: Name of the existing Space tag to apply.

task_id.description: ID of the task to tag.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: add_tag_to_task
